hits.snippet: Clarity Systems, an AI powered company that can detect retail fraud by seeing inside returned products without having to open them, said it has just closed a $4.4 million seed round. ... In a statement, it said the funding was backed by LMnT Ventures, with participation from Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures. ... “Return fraud is a stubborn, massive problem hiding in plain sight, costing the world’s largest brands billions and ultimately leaving everyday consumers to foot the bill.
